items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide security clearance; blocked for public exposure and security-sensitive releases; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Concrete evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or control results; operations deploy-health, uptime, and error sweeps have no results; authentication and access boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release approvals and provenance, dependency controls, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, complete TLS posture, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. No certificates are reported expiring within 30 days, but this does not establish complete TLS coverage. Compliance is technical-only with 37 pass, 15 fail, and 7 unknown, including open banner, consent, analytics, privacy, and terms findings. Risk severity is high for public exposure and security-sensitive releases, medium for bounded growth. Exact decision: preserve private launch gates; permit only reversible growth that adds no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior; continue the existing bounded read-only evidence matrix without duplicate requests, production changes, or claims of certification.

Continue the existing bounded read-only security evidence matrix using authorized metadata and retained artifacts only. Do not access credentials or private containers, change permissions or configuration, add dependencies, deploy, requeue failures, or conduct external outreach.
